name: hlbina
description: HLBINA: a 2.5D dig, sell and upgrade game.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.sim:economy: vite build --ssr scripts/simEconomy.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/sim-economy --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node node_modules/.cache/sim-economy/simEconomy.js
scripts.playtest: vite build --ssr scripts/playtest.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/playtest --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node node_modules/.cache/playtest/playtest.js
